description: Runs JavaScript in the open page and returns what it returns, as JSON. In scope: scene, camera, renderer, find(name), stats(target) (vertices, triangles, bounds, closed, volume, genus per mesh), realNow() and window. performance.now and Date run on the harness's paused clock, so to time code here use realNow() (real milliseconds), and end GPU work with a 1-pixel gl.readPixels before reading it. Use it to inspect the scene, try a change before writing it into the source, measure an imported model, or check procedural geometry with stats after each step; changes vanish on reload.
